title: What happens in S phase?
hook: See how chromosomes change during the cell cycle.

doesNotKnow: The events associated with stages of the eukaryotic cell cycle.

misconception: DNA replication and chromosome separation happen at the same time.
objective: Connect an event with its cell-cycle stage.

claims.text: Which event is associated with S phase in a typical eukaryotic cell? S phase: Nuclear DNA is replicated. Stages are a useful description of a continuous process.
The cell is schematic; the drawings are not to scale and omit many structures.
